community_note.text: Humans have used 'love' for objects, concepts, and activities for centuries. Examples include 'I love this book,' 'I love swimming,' 'I love democracy.' This is documented extensively in linguistic studies and common speech patterns across English-speaking cultures. [1][2][3]
